description: Labels threads matching a Gmail search query and optionally archives them. Dry-run is on by default, so it logs what it would do before changing anything.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Set Script Properties: TRIAGE_QUERY, TRIAGE_LABEL, ARCHIVE_AFTER, DRY_RUN.
Run triageInbox() once and check the execution log (dry run).
Set DRY_RUN to false only when the log looks right, then run it again.
title: Gmail Inbox Triage
